verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and calendar ACL rules that grant users or groups an access level to a calendar. That is calendar sharing, an adjacent feature, not a way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials (e.g., OAuth scopes or restricted tokens) for an agent. No evidence covers credential issuance or scoping, so this applicable axis has no documented support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: An access control rule granting a user (or a group of users) a specified level of access to a calendar.
